degraded_seats.note: Applied only when state.json.preflight.mode is 'degraded-claude-only' (product/onboarding/preflight.md check 2 fails). Every seat below is a same-family Claude substitute for a seat this config's own "seats" section names as GPT-5.6-Sol-only, so no seat parks in degraded mode and the build completes end to end. The honest trade-off is losing cross-family error decorrelation — two different model families being wrong in different, uncorrelated ways — never a loss of throughput or a skipped seat.

implementer.note: Fable-never-implements ban still holds; Opus already owns UI/creative implementation in full-cross-family mode and becomes the sole degraded-mode implementer for every chunk, not just UI/creative ones.

chunk_review_of_claude_work.note: The reviewer must be a Claude model different from the chunk's own author, so degraded mode still gets two distinct minds on every chunk.

note: A declared dated bet on which model sits in which seat — not a measurement; refreshed event-driven. A dated config is immutable once written: routing changes by adding a new dated file and repointing routing/active.json, never by editing these bytes, so a rollback is a repoint and the exact table any past run used stays readable. Every seat mirrors its agent's own frontmatter model and effort (agents/*.md), so an agent spawned directly and the same agent dispatched through this table run identically — a seat here is the dated record of that pairing, not a second, competing source of truth. The session that orchestrates has no seat here: the operator opens it at any model and effort, and every heavy think happens in a worker pinned at spawn. degraded_seats governs Claude-only operation; bans hold in every mode.
